List Rules
Vote for your favorite season of The Vampire Diaries.
All the seasons of The Vampire Diaries were great, but which seasons really stand out? For Elena Gilbert, the only thing more scandalous than a love triangle is a love triangle involving two brothers who are vampires. Some of the most memorable episodes of The Vampire Diaries come from different seasons, so picking the top season isn't easy. To determine once and for all what the best seasons of The Vampire Diaries are, let's rank every The Vampire Diaries season from best to worst.
The Vampire Diaries is an American supernatural teen drama series – based on L.J. Smith's book series of the same name– that follows the inhabitants of Mystic Falls including doppelgangers, vampires, werewolves and other supernatural beings. The Vampire Diaries premiered on The CW on September 10, 2009, and aired eight seasons before concluding on March 10, 2017. The talented cast includes Nina Dobrev, Paul Wesley, and Ian Somerhalder.
Vote up your favorite seasons of The Vampire Diaries, and vote down any bad seasons that you really didn't enjoy, despite how much you loved any individual episodes.
